Brazos Valley Fabrication

Brazos Valley Fabrication is a family-owned structural steel fabrication and welding shop. We manufacture stair, rail and structural packages for commercial contractors across North Texas.

Founded in 1978. Our 45,000 sq ft plant runs two shifts with 85 employees and a fleet of 12 trucks.

AWS D1.1 certified welders. ISO 9001 registered quality system.
